immigration.label: Voted yes on S.5, the Laken Riley Act, Jan 22 2025 (House roll call 23); campaign site calls for 'finishing the wall, and deporting criminal illegal aliens' (roll call plus campaign site)

taxes.label: Voted yes on H.R. 1, the 2025 tax law, Jul 3 2025 (House roll call 190); campaign site backs efforts to 'cut taxes, promote free markets, and control government spending' (roll call plus campaign site)

education.label: 'Parents should be in the driver's seat of their children's education'; voted for the Parents Bill of Rights (campaign site)

safety.label: Will 'ensure our officers have the necessary resources' and 'never allow radical left-wing politicians to defund the police' (campaign site)

repro.label: 'Pro-life and always has been,' advocating for 'the prohibition of late-term abortions' (campaign site)

democracy.label: Voted yes on H.R. 22, the SAVE Act proof-of-citizenship voting bill, Apr 10 2025 (House roll call 102)

health.label: Voted aye on H.R.1, the 2025 reconciliation law that cut federal Medicaid spending roughly $911B over 10 years via nationwide work requirements (clerk.house.gov roll 190, Jul 3, 2025)

cost.label: Job Creation plank promotes getting 'government out of the way' for small businesses, supporting tax cuts and free markets (erinhouchin.com/issues)

climate.label: Voted yes on H.J.Res. 88, disapproving California's EPA waiver for its EV/clean-car sales mandate (clerk.house.gov roll 114, May 1, 2025)

nullNotes.housing: re-checked Sep 2, 2026: erinhouchin.com/issues covers border security, Israel, government spending, abortion, conservative values, parental rights, veterans, law and order, job creation, Second Amendment, no housing statement

candidates.name: Bradley Allen Meyer
candidates.background: Democratic nominee challenging Rep. Erin Houchin in Indiana's 9th District.

health.label: Supports 'Medicare for All because no one should have to go broke just trying to stay alive' (campaign site)

cost.label: 'Fighting for higher wages, fair taxes, and restoring the collective bargaining power that built the middle class' (campaign site)

housing.label: Focused on 'making it possible to buy a first home again' (campaign site)

education.label: Committed to 'lowering the cost of education' (campaign site)
